content: Sa7oole Ammano
Sa7ooli Godaa ammaniza asaa wodhanaas ceeqettishe qeeseta halaqaakko bides.
Godaa oge kaallizayta maccassatanne addeta demmi qachchidi Yerusalaame ekki yaanaas Damasqo geetettizason diza Ayhudata Woosa Keeththas dabdaabe xaafana mala qeeseta halaqaa woossides.
Damasqo gakkana matishin qoppontta saloppe poo7oy iza yuushon pol7u gides.
Izikka heerakka biitta bolla kundidi saloppe, «Sa7oole, Sa7oole, tana aazas goodday?» giza qaala siyides.
Sa7oolikka, «Godoo! Ne oonee?» gides. Izikka izas, «Tani ne goodeththiza Yesusaakko!
Ne ha7i dendada gede katama gela; ne ooththanaas bessizaaz nees ta yootana» gides.
Sa7oolera issife biza asati qaala giiris sissafe attiin oonakka be7ontta gishshas ba doona oykki eqqida.
Sa7ooli ba kundidasohoppe dendidi ayfe doyi xeelliza wode aykkoka demmanaas dandaybeenna; hessa gishshas izara diza asati iza kushe oykkidi kaaleththi ekkidi Damasqo efida.
Heedzdzu gallas gakkanaas qooqidi kath haath beyibeenna.
Damasqon issi Hanaaniya geetettiza ammanizaadey dees; izas Goday ajjuutan, «Hanaaniya» giidi xeygides; izikka, «Yee Godoo!» gides.
Godaykka iza, «Denda! Suure geetettiza ogeyra Yuhuda geetettizaso ba. Heen Sa7oole geetettiza issi Xarseese asi woossishe dees; ne iza koya demma.
Gaasoykka Hanaaniya geetettizayssi Sa7ooli dizaso yiidi izi xeellana mala iza bolla ba kushe woththishin ajjuutan be7ides.»
Hanaaniyaykka zaaridi, «Godoo! Hayssaadey Yerusalaamen diza geeshshata bolla ay mala iita meto gaththidaakko ta daro asappe siyadis.
Izi haa yiday ne sunththaa xeygizayta ubbaa qachchanaas qeeseta halaqatappe godateth ekkidikko» gides.
Godaykka izas, «Ne ba! Hayssi addezi Ayzaabeta sinththaninne kawota sinththan hessaththoka Isra7eele dere sinththan ta sunth tookkana mala izi taas doorettidayssa.
Izi ta sunththaa gishshas ay mala waaye beyanaakko ta iza bessana» gides.

Hanaaniyay biidi izas yootettidaso gelides. Sa7oole bolla ba kushe woththidi, «Ta isha Sa7oole ne haa yishin nees oge bolla qonccida Godaa Yesusi ne ayfey xeellana malanne neni Xillo Ayanan kumana mala tana neekko kiittides» gides.
Heerakka Sa7oole ayfeppe poqo malay poqetti wodhdhiin izi xeellana dandaydessinne dendidi xammaqettides.
Kaththika miidi minnides; undenna wode ammanizaytara Damasqon gam7ides.
Sa7ooli Damasqoninne Yerusalaamen Tamaarsida Timirte
Heerakka Yesusi Xoossa Naa gididayssa Ayhudata Woosa Keeththatan tamaarso oykkides.
Siyida asay wuri, «Hayssi Yerusalaamen ha sunththaa xeygizayta dhayssiza addeza gidennee? Qasse izi haa yiday he asata qachchi ekki qeeseta halaqataakko efanaas deennee?» gishe malalettida.
Sa7ooli kaseppe minni minni bides; Damasqon diza Ayhudatas Yesusi izi Xoossi kiittidaade gididayssa ammanththishe asaa doona oyththides.
Daro gallassatappe guye Ayhudati Sa7oole wodhanaas duulatida.
Izikka istta qofaa erides; isttika iza wodhanaas katamaa gelththiza ogen gallassinne qamma naagida.
Ammanizayti gidikko iza giddoth katamaa yuushon diza maskootezara keeshen duge woththida.
Sa7ooli Yerusalaame yiidi ammanizaytara walakettana koyiin izi tumu ammanizaade gididayssa istti ammanettontta gishshas izas babbida.

Gido attiin Barnabaasi iza Hawaaretakko efiin Sa7ooli izi Damasqo oge bolla Godaa wostti be7idaakko, Godaykka izas ay yootidaakkonne Damasqon dishe izi ay mala xalateththara Yesusa sunththan sabbakidaakko isttas yootides.
Hessa gishshas Sa7ooli isttara dides; Yerusalaamen yuuyi yuuyi asas babbontta Godaa sunththan tamaarsides.
Girike dereppe yida Ayhudatara haasayshe palamettides; gido attiin asaykka iza wodhanaas koyides.
Ammanizayti hessa eridi duge Qisaariya geetettizaso woththidi Xarseese yeddida.
He wode Yuhudaninne Galilan, Samaariyankka diza ammanizayti saron diidi kaseppe minnida; qasseka Xoossa yashshateththan simerettishe Xillo Ayanan minettidanne kaseppe qoodan dari dari bida.
Eeniyanne Dorqa
Phexroosi dereppe deren yuuyishe Liida kataman diza ammanizayta beyanaas duge wodhdhides.
Heen Eeniya geetettizayssa osppun layth hiixan qashetti uttida issi gunda as demmides.
Phexroosikka, «Haysso Eeniya! Yesus Kirstoosi nena paththana; dendada ne hiixa denththa!» gides; Eeniyay heerakka pusuku gi dendides.
Liidaninne Saroonan diza asay wuri iza be7idi Godaan ammanides.
Iyophphe geetettizason Xaabita geetettiza issi ammanizaara dawus; izi sunththaa birsheththi Girike qaalara, «Dorqa» geetettees; iza ubba wode lo7o ooso minna ooththashenne manqota maaddashe dawus.
He wode iza hargada hayqqiin asay ahaza meecci pude pooqen kessi woththides.
Liiday Iyophphes mata gidida gishshas ammanizayti Phexroosi Liidan dizayssa siyidi nam7u asata kiittidi, «Elle haa yarkkii!» gi woossida.
Phexroosikka dendidi kiitettida asatara gakkida wode iza pude pooqe bolla kessida; am7etikka wuri iza yuuyi aadhdhi eqqidi Dorqay paxa dashe isttara ooththida qamisatanne may7ota bessishe yeekkida.
Phexroosikka ubba asaa kifilezappe kessidi gulbati woossides. Ahaakko simmidi, «Hanne Xaabita denda!» gides. Izakka ba ayfe doyada xeelladus; Phexroosakka beyada denda uttadus.
Izikka izi kushe oykki denththides. Ammanizaytanne am7eta xeygidi izo isttas paththi immides.
He hanoy kumeththa Iyophphen erettidessinne daro asaykka Godaa ammanides.
Phexroosikka issi Simoona geetettiza galba qaacizaadera Iyophphen daro wode de7ides.

footnotes.text: Issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafata birsheththay, «Qara mashsha bolla ne eqqiko qohettana» gishin harati qasse, «Caddiza biratara ne eqettiko nees haa darana» gees.

Issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafa birsheththati Sa7ooli kokkoridinne yashshateththan malalettidi, «Godoo! Ta nees ay ooththana mala dosay?» gides giza qofaa gujjeettes. Hessika shempo 22:10nne 26:14 bolla xaafetti beettees.
